### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

Issue Number: close #34096 

Problem Summary:

Track the memory usage in update and delete executors.

### What is changed and how it works?

Introduce a new generic type `MemAwareMap`.

issue_context.title: The memory consumed by `UpdateExec.updatedRowKeys` and `UpdateExec.mergedRowData` is not tracked
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
`updatedRowKeys` and `mergedRowData` in `UpdateExec` can use a large amount of memory but is not tracked in the memory tracker.

```update `T_CUSTOMER` set purse_num = purse_num + 1 where vip_level = '0'```
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31720476/163957379-95b2fb41-9f99-4923-9c49-dd55d60276ba.png)

```update T_CUSTOMER n, T_CUSTOMER m set n.purse_num=1, m.purse_num=2 where n.vip_level = '0'```
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31720476/164456856-b5353344-43f6-4b70-8b79-2307038c0211.png)

review_comments: This benchmark may be not convincing, I think we'd better add a microbenchmark for the MemAwareHandleMap.
I've updated results in the description.

1. A little question, if the handle is the same, then joinedRow must be the same?
2. When the exist it ture?

I don't remember the details of this part, but `exist` can be true. I tested it both in memory footprint numbers and in this way:
Let it panic here when `exist` is true and run:
```sql
MySQL root@172.16.5.181:CREDIT_CARD> insert into t_3 select * from t_2 where vip_level=0 limit 200000
Query OK, 200000 rows affected
Time: 7.873s
MySQL root@172.16.5.181:CREDIT_CARD> insert into t_4 select * from t_3 limit 10
Query OK, 10 rows affected
Time: 2.484s
MySQL root@172.16.5.181:CREDIT_CARD> explain analyze delete t_3, t_4 from t_3, t_4 where `t_3`.`vip_level` = `t_4`.`vip_level`
(1105, 'duplicate handle!!')
```
Can we add an individual package like `map` or `tiMap` to put these files?
Map and set are highly related. And `map` is reserved so I think leaving them in `set` is fine.
I don't find the usage of this function, It is necessary?
It's not used for now. But there may be places where we don't want to replace `map` with `MemAwareMap` but need to estimate the size of a `map`. For example the snapshot cache in client-go?
2 slice fields in CommonHandle. I'll add a comment.
